template.tagline: The workhorse: nine engines, two stages, big payload.
template.brief: Nine gas-generator kerosene engines on a 3.7 m first stage and a single vacuum engine above. Throwing the first stage away (expendable) lets it carry about 15 t to a 400 km orbit. Compare it with the reusable variant to see what landing costs.

benchmark.class: Medium-lift two-stage kerolox, nine-engine first stage
benchmark.text: The medium-lift workhorse class carries tens of tonnes to low Earth orbit. A cluster of nine engines gives engine-out tolerance and lets one engine design be mass-produced for both stages.
